*UnidosUS is a nonprofit, nonpartisan organization that serves as the nation’s largest Hispanic civil rights and advocacy organization. Since 1968, we* have built a stronger America by creating opportunities for Latinos and *breaking down barriers to expand economic and social progress for all. UnidosUS partners with an* *Affiliate Network* *of nearly 300 community\-based organizations across the United States and Puerto Rico. * Support as a liaison with grantees, community‑based organizations, and external partners to strengthen program visibility and impact.
* Represent the Education team, as appropriate and under supervision, in select external meetings, webinars, and partner convenings to share program updates and gather insights.

jobs.title: Billing & Account Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us:**



Cage \& Miles is one of the largest and fastest\-growing family law firms in Southern California. Our clients trust us to guide them through some of the most important moments of their lives, and we take that responsibility seriously. We are committed to delivering exceptional service through a team of talented professionals who lead with expertise, compassion, and integrity.



Our growth is fueled by a culture that values collaboration, continuous improvement, and investing in our people. We believe great teams don't happen by accident \- they are built through mentorship, professional development, clear expectations, and opportunities to grow.



As we continue to expand, we're looking for individuals who are motivated, client\-focused, and excited to help shape the future of our firm. If you're looking for a place where your contributions matter and your career can grow alongside the organization, we'd love to meet you.  

  

**Job Summary:**

The Billing \& Account Coordinator oversees a portfolio of client matters for assigned attorneys, ensuring accounts are managed with both urgency and care. This client\-facing role requires strong subject\-matter expertise in billing, collections, and account management. The ideal candidate is a polished, confident communicator who takes ownership of tasks from start to finish, works efficiently, and makes sound decisions. Strong problem\-solving skills and emotional intelligence are essential when addressing account issues and navigating difficult conversations with empathy, sound judgment, and respect. The right candidate is proactive and detail\-oriented, takes pride in maintaining accurate, audit\-ready work, and contributes to a supportive, collaborative team while delivering consistently positive client experience.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Manage a portfolio of client matters, ensuring accurate billing, collections, trust balances, and account activity while keeping accounts in good standing.
* Monitor accounts to identify outstanding balances, upcoming financial needs, and potential issues, using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.
* Partner closely with attorneys and paralegals to communicate account status, address retainer needs and resolve financial matters.
* Proactively communicate with clients by phone, email, and text regarding billing, outstanding balances, payments, and account concerns with professionalism and empathy.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks from start to finish, using sound judgment, problem\-solving skills, and firm systems to work efficiently and accurately.
* Maintain precise, audit\-ready documentation and contribute to a collaborative team environment while maintaining confidentiality and providing a consistently positive client experience.


**Qualifications:**


* Experience in customer service, account management, collections, billing, client relations, or a similar client\-facing role; prior law firm or professional services experience is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with confidence and experience communicating by phone, email, and text.
* Strong emotional intelligence, interpersonal skills, and the ability to navigate sensitive or difficult conversations with professionalism, empathy, and sound judgment.
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage a high volume of client matters, prioritize competing demands, and maintain accurate, audit\-ready records.
* Proactive and resourceful, with the ability to take initiative, make sound decisions, identify issues, and follow through without constant direction.
* Comfortability discussing financial matters, including billing, outstanding balances, payments, and retainers, while maintaining a professional and client\-focused approach.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; college education in business, accounting, finance, or a related field is preferred.

  


* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook); experience with Clio, Super Set, or similar account management systems is a plus.

  


**Additional Information:**


* This position can be fully remote or hybrid, with the option to work out of any of our offices, Monday – Friday from 8:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m

  


* The anticipated compensation for this role is $22 \- $26 per hour, but ultimately will depend on experience.

  


* Cage \& Miles has been named a Top Workplace by the San Diego Union \-Tribune, ranking \#2 among businesses with 50\-149 employees. This is a meaningful achievement driven by the voices of our employees and our shared commitment to excellence.

This is a full\-time hybrid in\-office role (WFH 2 days a week, in office 3 days a week). We are looking for someone interested in a long\-term career at RAGDOLL PR and who is interested in growing within the company.

JOB SUMMARY:

This role is responsible for engaging with pertinent social media influencers, celebrities, celebrity stylists, stylists, etc. to ensure RAGDOLL PR brands are consistently being featured on influencers and on various celebrities and stylists. Part of the role requires an understanding of fashion, beauty, and lifestyle influencer/celebrity space to ensure we are aware of all of them. The position drives the storytelling aspect of the brand and is responsible for not only telling each brand story but consistently coming up with unique ways to make RAGDOLL PR brands/clients stand out to influencers and to celebrities and celebrity stylists. In order to tell each brand story, the account manager must develop and produce press releases, launch innovative campaigns, create media alerts, and draft day\-to\-day pitches for various market stories. This position also manages several of our clients' Instagram accounts and is responsible for posting daily, interacting on IG, and overseeing many aspects of clients' social media accounts.

RAGDOLL PR is a full service PR agency based in Manhattan Beach (Los Angeles). We specialize in influencer seeding and coordination as well as editorial, media placements, and celebrity seeding.

\* Social Media management and engagement for RAGDOLL PR brands

\* Management of Influencer collaborations from start to finish

jobs.title: Tour & Talent Account Manager, Shows
jobs.description:
At Yondr, we believe in the power of presence. Our mission is to create phone\-free spaces that deepen human connection and elevate shared experiences. We partner with artists, educators, and visionaries to design environments that put people, not devices, at the center.


Yondr’s business segments span numerous industries, primarily across education and live events. Yondr supports schools through cell phone\-free programs. Our education programs facilitate the successful implementation of phone\-free school environments by providing administrators and teachers with education, training, and development resources, along with all necessary equipment. In addition, Yondr supports top artists in music and comedy by creating phone\-free shows, allowing performers and audience members to enjoy live performances without the distraction of phones.

**SUMMARY**


Yondr is seeking an Account Manager / Sales Lead to drive new business and manage key client relationships across the Shows vertical. Reporting to the Director of Music \& Events, this role sits at the intersection of artist relations and commercial execution — owning outreach and deal development with artist teams, agents, and promoters while ensuring seamless account management for confirmed tours and engagements. The ideal candidate is relationship\-driven, commercially sharp, and deeply fluent in the live entertainment ecosystem.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

***Business Development \& Sales***

* Identify and pursue new business opportunities across music, comedy, and adjacent live entertainment verticals.
* Conduct proactive outreach to artist managers, booking agents, and promoters to develop and convert new Yondr shows.
* Own end\-to\-end deal management from initial pitch through contract execution, working closely with the Director on pricing, proposals, and negotiation.
* Maintain and grow a qualified pipeline of prospective artists and tours, with consistent forecasting and reporting to the Director.
* Support expansion into underdeveloped verticals including EDM, Country, sports, and emerging markets — with Theater and Broadway as active near\-term priorities.
* Collaborate with the Director on agency and promoter relationship strategy, including participation in key industry conferences and events.

***Account Management***

* Serve as the primary day\-to\-day point of contact for a portfolio of confirmed Shows clients.
* Manage client expectations, coordinate logistics, and ensure a high level of service from deal close through show execution.
* Collaborate closely with the Production team to ensure seamless handoff of confirmed engagements.
* Identify upsell and extension opportunities within existing accounts, including multi\-show and touring deals.
* Collect and track final ticket counts, billing documentation, and post\-show reporting.

***Relationship Development***

* Build and maintain strong, ongoing relationships with artist teams, agencies, promoters, and venues.
* Represent Yondr at industry events, showcases, and conferences in alignment with the department's visibility strategy.
* Contribute to the development of vertical sales materials, pitch decks, and artist testimonials in partnership with the Director and Marketing.

***Operations \& Reporting***

* Maintain accurate deal and client records in Airtable and internal systems.
* Support pipeline tracking, forecasting, and margin reporting in coordination with the Director and Finance.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives including pricing strategy, contract overhaul, and new service rollouts.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5–8 years of experience in artist relations, talent agency, music business, promotions, or live entertainment sales.
* Established relationships across the live entertainment ecosystem — artist management, booking agencies, promoters, or venues.
* Proven track record of closing deals and managing long\-term client relationships in a commercial context.
* Strong commercial instincts including comfort with pricing, proposals, and contract negotiation.
* Relationship\-driven and non\-transactional — able to build trust with artist teams and industry partners.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable representing Yondr externally.
* Experience with Airtable, CRM platforms, or pipeline management tools.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving environment with a high degree of autonomy.
* International experience is a plus, particularly in European touring or EDM markets.
* Genuine enthusiasm for and fluency in the live entertainment landscape.

**YONDR BENIFITS**

* 100% paid medical coverage plan option for employees and access to 15\+ plan types, including PPO, HMO and HDHP
* Dental and vision and ancillary benefits such as short\-term disability, long\-term disability and life insurance
* Generous PTO for rest and recharge throughout the year
* 12 weeks of paid parental leave
* 1 week paid holiday break at the end of December, for a company\-wide closure \+ 11 additional nationally recognized holidays
* 401(k) offering
* Tech tool preference, including choice of PC or Mac.
* Hybrid employees receive catered lunch twice a week.

*Yondr is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate in its hiring of employees based on race, religion, gender, or sexual orientation.*

Compensation Range: $80K \- $90K

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hybrid’s humble beginnings started in 1997 in the back of a print shop designing, selling, and printing tee shirts. Today, Hybrid is a global apparel industry powerhouse in brand and licensing management. Hybrid provides its expertise and fully vertical operations capability – design, merchandising, development, sourcing, production, and distribution – to a broad suite of branded, licensed, generic, and private label partners. Hybrid’s full\-service apparel design and manufacturing expertise extends across the apparel category, including knits, woven tops, bottoms, tees, and accessories.


As our organization has evolved, so has our philosophy of doing business. We have made concerted efforts to remove ourselves from the antiquated approach of other apparel manufacturers and doing things differently has been our focus. We are building a company ethos that breeds innovation, collaboration, integrity and excellence in customer service.

**What is my role?**


Work closely with Sales and Senior Account Manager in conjunction with other various departments to assist in the daily functions of managing the orders and accounts.

**What You'll Do**

* Work with Order Management to and review weekly open order and sample reports.
* Attend weekly production meetings.
* Review worksheets processed from Sales to make sure detailed information is correct (i.e. style numbers, wash, treatment details, ground colors, etc.).
* Follow up on testing if required.
* Attend Production handoff meeting.
* Track sample ETA’s and ensure arrivals and approvals are within the allotted lead\-times.
* Follow up with License Dept. on approvals, art status, and PP on licensed products
* Communicate approvals to Pre\-Pro Dept. and Prod Dept.
* Work with Garment Wash Dept. for sample needs.
* Ensure account specific forms are completed and sent with packages.
* Complete cost sheet and upload into Unity.
* Submit CAD request for order processing.
* Process production order worksheets in Unity for full package; process via email for blanks with tear away.
* Enter information into sample portal.
* Order blanks.
* Submit pad print request and approve details of pad prints.
* Organize and maintain sample racks for internal reference.
* Prepare and send approval items to the customers (i.e. lab dips, fit samples, pp samples, bulk fabric, TOP’s, etc.).
* Ship out samples (PP’s, TOP’s, Ad) and items for approval (lab dips, fit, bulk submissions, etc.) with correct internal references.
* Other duties may be assigned in accordance with company needs

**What You'll Need**

* BA or AA in a Fashion related field preferred
* 3\+ years’ experience in account management within the apparel industry
* Detail oriented and very organized
* This position must push for results and constantly follow up with others.
* Good communication skills
* Proficient with MS Office and Excel. Computer comfort as all tasks are done on various programs (i.e. sample portal, unity, art portal, inventory portal)
* Able to work in hectic environment and with tight deadlines
* Need to be able to juggle many tasks simultaneously
* Ability to work until the job is done. There are often extra hours spent at end of day.
* Must be self\-motivated and comfortable working without constant managerial follow up

We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end\-to\-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. Structured tenure pay increases and an uncapped commissions plan offers you unlimited earnings potential. jobs.title: Remote Social Media Manager and Content Creator
jobs.description:
We’re looking for an experienced **Freelance Social Media Manager** to support an established hair and beauty business based in Inglewood.

This is a good fit for someone who can take ownership of the social media function, bring ideas to the table, and keep content moving without needing constant direction. We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for content to be handed to them and posts it.

**This is a remote 1099 independent contractor opportunity, not an employee position.**

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and manage monthly content plans that support consistent daily posting across the brand’s social platforms
* Batch\-create and prepare content in advance to maintain a consistent daily content cadence
* Help identify content themes, campaigns, and opportunities that make sense for the brand
* Contribute ideas and recommendations that strengthen the overall social media direction
* Write engaging captions, calls to action, and other social copy that align with the brand’s voice
* Schedule and publish approved content across relevant social platforms
* Repurpose existing photo and video assets into additional social content
* Plan and communicate what photo and video content should be captured to support upcoming content plans, campaigns, and social media needs
* Create shot lists, content briefs, or other guidance that helps the person responsible for content capture understand what is needed
* Organize social media content and digital assets for easy access and reuse
* Monitor content performance and use insights to improve future content
* Stay aware of relevant social media trends and identify the ones that make sense for the brand
* Communicate proactively about content needs, approvals, priorities, and opportunities

**What We’re Looking For**

You should have demonstrated experience managing social media for a business or brand and be comfortable taking meaningful ownership of your work.

**The ideal candidate:**

* Has professional social media management experience
* Can demonstrate previous work through a portfolio, examples, or relevant accounts
* Understands how brand voice, audience, goals, and positioning should influence content
* Is comfortable developing ideas and making recommendations
* Can work independently while knowing when client input or approval is needed
* Has strong written communication and copywriting skills
* Understands short\-form video and social\-first content
* Understands what makes strong photo and video content for social media and can provide clear direction for content capture
* Is comfortable batching, planning, and scheduling content in advance
* Is organized and able to manage content calendars, deadlines, approvals, and digital assets
* Can interpret basic social media performance data and use it to improve future content
* Is reliable, responsive, and comfortable working directly with a business owner

*Experience with hair, beauty, lifestyle, or other visually driven consumer brands is a plus, but it’s not required.*

**Experience with social media strategy is also a bonus.** While this role is primarily focused on social media management and execution, we’d love someone who can contribute thoughtful ideas, help shape content direction, and make recommendations based on the brand’s goals and performance.

**This May Not Be a Fit If...**

This opportunity may not be the right fit if your experience is primarily limited to scheduling pre\-created posts or you prefer receiving detailed instructions for every piece of content.

We’re looking for someone who can bring strong execution, initiative, creativity, and good judgment to the role.

Pay: Up to $1,600\.00 per month

Work Location: Remote

VITAS® Healthcare is the nation’s leading provider of end\-of\-life care, and has the resources and expertise to support your personal and professional growth. As a member of the VITAS team, you’ll find fulfillment working for a people\-focused organization dedicated to making a difference in the lives of others. You will be more than just an employee: You will be counted on as an expert in your field, and as a valued team member whose efforts are respected and vital to our hospice mission.


All VITAS employees commit to fulfilling their duties and responsibilities with the highest regard for professionalism, collaboration and teamwork, and an eye focused constantly on growth and improvement. jobs.title: Specialty Sales Representative – Cardiometabolic Rare Disease
jobs.description:
Location: East Los Angeles, CA, United States  

Date Updated: Sep 4, 2026  

Job ID: 18078


  
**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Territory \& Strategic Business Planning**

* Develop and execute comprehensive, data\-driven territory business plans aligned to brand strategy and launch objectives.
* Analyze territory data (prescribing trends, account potential, access landscape) to identify growth opportunities and prioritize high\-value targets.
* Manage territory budget responsibly, including speaker programs and promotional initiatives.
* Consistently achieve or exceed sales goals and performance metrics.

**Prescriber Activation \& Clinical Engagement**

* Deliver compelling, compliant, and clinically accurate product education within approved labeling.
* Articulate complex clinical data and value propositions tailored to cardiologists, lipid specialists, endocrinologists, and targeted PCPs.
* Differentiate Arrowhead therapies within a competitive and evolving cardiometabolic landscape.
* Execute speaker programs, educational events, and peer\-to\-peer engagements to drive awareness and adoption.
* Support appropriate patient identification and therapy initiation through thoughtful provider engagement.

**Stakeholder \& Account Management**

* Build and sustain strong, trust\-based relationships with healthcare professionals, office staff, and institutional stakeholders.
* Navigate complex health systems and coordinate effectively within IDNs in partnership with Key Account Managers.
* Identify access barriers and collaborate with Market Access and patient services to support pull\-through.
* Maintain consistent, high\-quality engagement and service across accounts to drive durable utilization.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Health IT, and Patient Services to align territory execution with enterprise strategy.
* Provide actionable field insights regarding market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer feedback.

**Compliance \& Operational Excellence**

* Maintain full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and promotional standards.
* Accurately document field activity and manage CRM reporting in a timely manner.
* Demonstrate disciplined execution, accountability, and ethical conduct in all engagements.

**Travel \& Engagement**

* Represent Arrowhead at regional and national meetings, training programs, and key conferences (\~30% travel required).
* Overnight travel may be necessary depending on territory geography.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

**Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience and minimum 5 years of pharmaceutical sales experience required.
* Demonstrated success launching or expanding complex therapies requiring access navigation and clinical depth required.
* 3\+ years in specialty, rare disease, or cardiovascular therapeutic areas strongly preferred.
* Experience working within integrated delivery networks (IDNs) or complex healthcare systems preferred.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong territory planning and account management capabilities with a data\-driven mindset.
* Ability to interpret and communicate complex clinical data confidently and credibly.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship\-building skills.
* High level of

jobs.title: Business Sales Representative
jobs.description:
**Company Overview:**  

  

ADT has been in the business of helping save lives since 1874\. As the \#1 smart home security provider in the U.S., we help protect and connect families, businesses and larger commercial customer every day. Our continuous innovation, advanced technology and strategic partnerships deliver products and services that help protect life and valuables, whether at home, your business or on the go. And as times change, so do we.Above all, our mission is clear: we help save lives for a living. Looking for a career where you can make a real impact? Join our team today and put purpose behind your paycheck. \#WeAreADT
*Check out more about life at ADT* here.
**What you should know about our team:**


At ADT, our Sales team is at the heart of everything we do. We’re not just selling security systems, we’re helping protect what matters most. Whether it’s a family home or a small business, our sales professionals are trusted advisors who bring peace of mind to customers across the country.


**What you will do:**


You’ll use your strong communication and creative problem\-solving skills to demonstrate the value of our innovative security and smart business solutions to small business customers while explaining our products and services in depth and recommending the right options for their needs. You’ll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, partnering closely with business owners, decision\-makers, and teammates. This role involves providing tailored solutions by visiting customers at their businesses. You will:


* Listen and build trust: By showing up with integrity, empathy, and expertise, you’ll become a reliable advisor small business owners can count on throughout the sales process and beyond.
* Customize each system to fit the business’s layout, operations, and security needs, combining security, automation, and life\-safety technology in ways that support how they work.
* Conduct post\-installation follow\-ups with customers to confirm commitments were fulfilled and strengthen long\-term relationships and referrals.
* Cultivate new business opportunities: identify and generate new small business leads within your territory to maximize outreach and growth.

**What you need to be successful:**


We’re looking for self\-motivated, tech\-savvy individuals who are passionate about helping others and driven to succeed. If you thrive on connection, enjoy solving problems, and want to make a real impact while growing your career, you’ll fit right in.


* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Willing to travel within a designated territory using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed).
* Valid driver’s license and clean driving record required; additional licensing may be needed based on location.
* Comfortable using technology to stay organized, efficient, and accountable in a fast\-paced sales environment.
* Self\-motivated and results\-driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset; you thrive on uncovering new leads and closing deals that deliver real value.
* Strong communicator and natural relationship builder, able to consult with customers, understand their needs, and guide them to the right solution.
* Adaptable and flexible; you excel in dynamic environments and enjoy learning new systems and approaches.
* Consumer sales experience is preferred but not required.

**How ADT invests in you:**


**Compensation:** Unlimited earning potential with uncapped commissions. Based upon performance, new sales advisors can expect to earn $85,000, while experienced sales advisors can earn over $150,000\.


**Additional Pay:** We equip you with specialized training and the tools you need to meet your financial goals. For your first 8 weeks of training, you’ll earn up to $4,000\.


**Benefits:**


* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Tuition reimbursement
* Mileage reimbursement
* Short\- and long\-term disability, life insurance, and well\-being programs
* Paid time off
* Culture of professional development and career growth opportunities.
* Flexible work schedule to accommodate you and your customers’ needs
* Click here to view our full benefit offerings.

**Why you’ll love working here:**


* We **boldly shape the future**, embracing change, taking smart risks, and continuously improving to create the best experiences.
* We **lead by taking ownership**, empowering you to make decisions, solve problems proactively, and support each other with empathy.
* We **elevate to serve a greater purpose**, going above and beyond to earn trust, celebrate wins, and value every perspective.
* We **unite and win together**, fostering teamwork, breaking down silos, and achieving shared goals through inclusivity and collaboration.

This role supports the assigned Area or Region with day\-to\-day sales activities and offers a strong pathway to a future Account Executive role. Through hands\-on training, the ASR will learn how to confidently demonstrate products to healthcare providers in both operating room and administrative settings, while executing the sales process in a clear, professional, and ethical way that drives results.  


Job Duties:  


Expand the sales of client products and to convert competitive products in a manner that complies with company policy and sales direction  
Support to the aligned Area/Region for all sales\-related activities, and upon successful completion of duties, will be eligible to compete for role as an Account Executive

Execute the selling cycle in a manner that is concise, professional, ethical, and which leads the customer to action.  


Additional job responsibilities include:  


Understand and demonstrate proper preparation and surgical use of all Mentor products.

Conduct sales presentations by using current selling methods learned in sales training courses.  
Troubleshoot and provide other technical assistance; handle customer requests, effectively manage hospital billing, create / close purchase orders.  
Maintenance, tracking and effective deployment of equipment, and assets throughout assigned area ensuring product availability. Ensure all promotional materials are maintained in a presentable manner. Ensure client’s services and offering meet highest quality standards

Participate and support in the commercialization / implementation of client’s new products and solutions with customer  
Support all administrative duties related to the role including consignment management, audits, inventory management, etc.

You'll take direction from the HR Operations Manager and work alongside Talent Acquisition and Payroll to keep every transaction moving on time.


Core Responsibilities


Onboarding

* Process new hire onboarding paperwork and system setup, from offer acceptance through Day 1

* Collect and verify new hire documentation, including I\-9s, tax forms, and employment eligibility paperwork
* Send new hire paperwork and welcome communications, and follow up to make sure everything is completed on time
* Request system and platform access (Rippling, email, and studio\-level tools) and coordinate equipment issuance for new hires ahead of their start date


Employee Changes

* Process pay, title, position, and location changes in Rippling as directed by the HR Operations Manager
* Prepare and send change paperwork (offer letters, addendums, notices) and confirm employee acknowledgment
* Update personnel records to reflect approved changes and confirm accuracy against source approvals
* Route compensation or classification changes to Payroll and confirm they land in the correct pay cycle


Leave of Absence (LOA) Administration

* Process leave of absence requests and paperwork, including FMLA, state\-mandated leave, and personal/medical leave

* Update Rippling records to reflect leave status, and route leave\-related pay and benefits changes to Payroll and Benefits
* Send leave\-related communications, including approval notices and return\-to\-work confirmations
* Maintain the LOA tracker and flag upcoming leave starts, returns, or expirations to the HR Operations Manager


Offboarding

* Process offboarding paperwork and checklist items for departing employees, including exit documentation
* Deactivate system and platform access and confirm return of company equipment on or before the last day
* Coordinate with Payroll to ensure final pay and benefits cessation details are handed off accurately
* Update personnel records to reflect termination details and rehire eligibility as directed


HR Inbox Triage

* Monitor the shared HR inbox and triage incoming requests, routing each to the correct owner (Payroll, Benefits, HR Operations Manager, or self)
* Respond directly to routine employee and manager questions on lifecycle, LOA, and general HR topics, escalating anything unclear

* Keep saved replies and inbox documentation up to date so responses stay consistent and on time


Records \& Compliance

* Keep personnel files organized, complete, and audit\-ready across all lifecycle stages
* Track checklist completion for onboarding, changes, LOA, and offboarding, and flag outstanding items
* Assist with I\-9 re\-verification and other compliance paperwork as deadlines come up


General

* Answer routine employee and manager questions on lifecycle transaction status, escalating anything unclear to the HR Operations Manager
* Keep lifecycle trackers and shared documentation up to date
* Provide general administrative support to the HR Operations Manager as needed


Required Qualifications

* 2\+ years of experience in HR, HR administration, or a related field preferred
* Experience with Rippling or a comparable HRIS platform preferred
* Comfortable with data entry and processing multiple employee transactions at once without missing deadlines
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially with employees during onboarding, changes, LOA, and offboarding
* Ability to handle confidential employee information with discretion

* Familiarity with I\-9 and employment eligibility verification requirements
* Familiarity with leave of absence administration, including FMLA and state leave programs
* Experience supporting employee lifecycle transactions in a multi\-location or multi\-unit environment
* Comfortable following established checklists and processes in a fast\-paced environment

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Want a career in social media?**

**This position will give you the creative freedom to build your portfolio and real career growth in a culture you’ll love being part of.**

**If you have a proven track record of helping grow a business or brand through social media, this role is for you.**

We’re a young \& energetic spinal rehab clinic in Tustin, active on all platforms, creating videos about our treatments, behind\-the\-scenes moments, case presentations, and our culture.

We currently serve hundreds of patients each month and are working toward **doubling the size of our practice and expanding into multiple locations across Orange County.** So, if you want to lead projects, have real influence, and find long\-term growth, join us!

**What You’ll Own**

* Research trends, competitors, hooks, and new content ideas.
* Write hooks, scripts, captions, and calls to action.
* Film content with our doctors and team, including treatments, educational videos, patient cases, behind\-the\-scenes moments, and office culture.
* Create graphics and edit photos/videos.
* Schedule and post approximately 8 pieces of content per day, including 4 videos and 4 photos/graphics, across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn.
* Engage with comments, messages, and our online community.
* Track content performance and identify what’s working.
* Develop and game plan new ideas for the following week.
* Meet with management weekly to review what worked, what didn’t, and what we’re creating next.

**Experience We’re Looking For**

* Social media/content creation experience.
* Experience creating short\-form videos, hooks, scripts, and captions.
* Experience filming and editing social media content.
* Experience using analytics to improve content performance.
* Must be able to show previous work and results.

**How Your Success Will Be Measured**

* Content Output: Content created, scheduled, and published.
* Consistency: Posting schedule and deadlines completed.
* Content Performance: Views, reach, engagement, shares, saves, and watch time.
* Audience Growth: Follower growth.
* New Ideas: New ideas generated, tested, and their results.
* Leads: Social media inquiries/leads when trackable.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM–6:00 PM (5 days a week)

**Our culture is energetic, supportive, and fun!**

* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/spinalperformance/
* Website: www.spinalperformance.com

Pay: From $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* What social media accounts have you personally managed? Please provide links.
* Send a link to one of the best\-performing VIDEOS you personally planned, filmed, edited, and posted. What results did it achieve?
* Send a link to one of the best\-performing PHOTOS/GRAPHICS you personally planned, created, edited, and posted. What results did it achieve?
* Tell us about a time the numbers showed your content wasn’t working. What did you change, and what happened afterward?

jobs.title: Landscape Account Manager
jobs.description:
**SGD Enterprises dba Four Seasons Landscaping** is seeking an experienced, highly organized, and hands\-on **Landscape Contract Project Manager** to oversee one of our largest and most complex municipal landscape maintenance contracts in the City of Irvine.

This is a high\-level operational position responsible for the **overall performance, staffing, quality control, reporting, and day\-to\-day execution of the contract**. The Project Manager will serve as the central point of accountability for the project and will work closely with company leadership, field supervisors, irrigation personnel, specialty crews, and City representatives to ensure that all contractual requirements are performed consistently, timely, safely, and to the exceptionally high standards expected by the City of Irvine.

This is **not simply an administrative project\-management position**. The successful candidate must have extensive practical knowledge of commercial landscape maintenance and be capable of walking a property, identifying deficiencies, understanding the appropriate corrective action, directing crews, and verifying that the work has been completed correctly.

Position Overview

The City of Irvine contract encompasses a large portfolio of parks and athletic facilities with extensive turf, athletic fields, landscaped planter areas, irrigation systems, environmental services, specialized turf\-management operations, fertilization, pest management, renovation work, and other technical landscape requirements.

Because of the **size, complexity, visibility, and performance expectations of this contract**, we are looking for a Project Manager who understands landscape maintenance at a professional level and can successfully manage both the people and the technical requirements necessary to deliver an exceptional product.

The ideal candidate will be someone who takes ownership of the project, anticipates problems before they become issues, maintains excellent communication with the City, and holds crews and supervisors accountable for consistently meeting contract specifications.

Key Responsibilities

* Assume overall responsibility for the **successful performance of the City of Irvine landscape maintenance contract**.
* Manage and oversee a large workforce consisting of mowing crews, landscape/detail crews, environmental crews, irrigation technicians, IPM personnel, athletic\-field personnel, supervisors, and specialty turf\-renovation crews.
* Develop and maintain weekly, monthly, seasonal, and annual work schedules to ensure that **every contractual requirement is completed within the required service frequency and timeframe**.
* Conduct frequent field inspections throughout the City to evaluate landscape quality, turf conditions, athletic fields, planter areas, irrigation performance, cleanliness, and overall contract compliance.
* Ensure that mowing, edging, detailing, pruning, fertilization, aeration, overseeding, topdressing, turf renovation, irrigation maintenance, pest\-management operations, and other specialized landscape activities are performed correctly.
* Coordinate equipment, vehicles, materials, crews, and subcontractors so work is completed efficiently and without interruption.
* Work directly with supervisors and crew leaders to correct deficiencies and improve productivity and quality.
* Manage employee scheduling, attendance, staffing needs, productivity, training, discipline, and overall field performance.
* Ensure sufficient staffing and equipment are available at all times to meet the City's service requirements.
* Oversee specialized **athletic\-field and sports\-turf maintenance**, including reel mowing, aeration, verticutting, deep\-tine aeration, topdressing, interseeding, turf renovation, fraise mowing, sod preparation, and related operations.
* Work closely with irrigation technicians to ensure irrigation systems are operating properly and repairs are completed promptly.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors for specialized work and material deliveries.
* Review contract specifications regularly and ensure field operations remain in full compliance.
* Prepare, complete, review, and submit **all reports, schedules, documentation, inspection records, work logs, service reports, and other information required by the City**.
* Track corrective\-action requests and ensure issues identified by the City are resolved quickly and documented appropriately.
* Attend meetings and site walks with City representatives and company leadership.
* Maintain professional and proactive communication with City staff.
* Monitor material usage, labor productivity, equipment utilization, and overall project efficiency.
* Assist company management with controlling project costs while **never sacrificing the quality or contractual performance expected by the City**.
* Ensure crews comply with all applicable safety requirements, company procedures, and City standards.
* Maintain accurate records relating to staffing, work performed, additional work, materials, equipment, and contract compliance.
* Recognize potential contractual issues or additional\-work opportunities and immediately communicate them to company management.
* Take complete ownership of the project and ensure that issues are followed through **from identification to final resolution**.

Landscape Knowledge Is Essential

This position requires considerably more landscape expertise than a traditional project\-management role.

The Project Manager must have a strong working understanding of areas including:

* Commercial and municipal landscape maintenance
* Sports\-field and athletic\-turf maintenance
* Reel and rotary mowing practices
* Turfgrass identification and management
* Fertilization programs
* Aeration, verticutting, overseeding and topdressing
* Turf renovation and establishment
* Shrub and groundcover maintenance
* Proper pruning techniques
* Weed identification and control
* Integrated Pest Management
* Irrigation tr

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.description:
At T\-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package \- this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth\-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year\-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!


\*\*\* This position may be located anywhere within the Mountain Time or Pacific Time Zones.
  

  

The Client Success Manager at T\-Mobile is a pivotal role focused on enhancing customer relationships and retention within the Government, Strategic, and Enterprise business segments. This position is responsible for managing the entire customer lifecycle, ensuring successful onboarding, product adoption, and continuous value realization. By identifying upsell and cross\-sell opportunities, the Client Success Manager works closely with sales teams to develop strategies that increase account value. Acting as a customer advocate, this role coordinates with multiple departments including sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet contract commitments and resolve issues. Through strategic business reviews and building trusted executive relationships, the Client Success Manager fosters long\-term partnerships and enhances client loyalty.
  

  

This role will support clients that reside on the West Coast of the United States other locations will be considered if they reside in this part of the country.**Job Responsibilities**:

* Customer Relationship Advocacy – Serve as the primary post\-sales point of contact for assigned government and enterprise accounts, advocating for customer needs across internal teams and ensuring a positive end\-to\-end experience. Build and maintain executive\-level relationships with client stakeholders to foster trust, understand business goals, and drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Onboarding Product Adoption – Oversee new customer onboarding and training to guarantee a smooth implementation from Day 0 onward. Educate customers on T\-Mobile for Business products, services, and self\-service tools (e.g. Account Hub) to accelerate product and solution adoption, ensuring clients realize full value from their investments. Develop customer success plans and conduct regular health checks.
* Account Health Monitoring Reviews – Proactively monitor account performance and health indicators (usage trends, service quality, billing, NPS, etc.) to identify signs of risk or opportunity. Lead regular success reviews and QBRs, presenting key performance metrics and insights to client executives. Recommend action plans to address service gaps or evolving needs.
* Issue Resolution Cross\-Functional Coordination – Take ownership of customer issues and coordinate cross\-functional resolution, engaging internal experts to troubleshoot and swiftly resolve problems. Act as the customer champion in internal discussions, documenting interactions and ensuring service levels are met. Drive timely resolutions to maintain operational continuity.
* Retention Renewal Management – Develop and execute strategies to retain customers and secure renewals, mitigating churn. Analyze account health data to identify at\-risk accounts or partial disconnect requests and address root causes proactively. Lead contract renewal processes, negotiate terms, and finalize agreements that maintain or grow revenue.
* Account Growth Upsell – Drive account expansion by identifying and executing cross\-sell and upsell opportunities based on customer needs and usage data. Prepare and present proposals for new solutions, partnering with Sales and Solutions Engineering on complex opportunities that align with customer goals.

 **Education and Work Experience**:

* Bachelor's Degree Business Administration, Management, or related field (Preferred)
* Master's/Advanced Degree Business Administration, Management, or related field (Preferred)
* 4\-7 years Managing customer relationships and account management in business segments such as Government, Strategic, or Enterprise (Required)
* 2\-4 years Coordinating with multiple departments such as sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet contract commitments and resolve issues (Required)
* 2\-4 years Collaborating with sales teams to identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and develop strategies to increase account value (Preferred)

 **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**:

* Client Relationship Management Strong skills in managing client relationships at an executive level, ensuring customer satisfaction and loyalty. (Required)
* Cross Functional Relationships Ability to coordinate with multiple departments such as sales, engineering, support, and operations to meet customer needs and resolve issues. (Required)
* Strategic Thinking Capability to develop strategic plans for customer account growth through upselling and cross\-selling. (Required)
* Problem Solving Proficient in identifying problems and coordinating resources to provide effective solutions. (Required)
* Leadership Experience in leading teams and managing a distributed workforce to achieve business goals. (Required)
* Analytics Ability to analyze customer data to identify trends and opportunities for business improvement. (Required)
* Business Acumen Strong understanding of business operations and the impact of customer success on overall business performance. (Required)
* Telecommunications Knowledge of telecommunications industry, particularly in wireless technologies, to better understand and serve client needs. (Required)

 **Licenses and Certifications**:

* Certified Customer Experience Professional (CCXP): Certification that validates expertise in customer experience management, enhancing skills in customer journey mapping, and strategic alignment to business goals. (Preferred)
* Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification b

We bring industry\-leading expertise to clients in enterprise, healthcare, education, government, data center, and retail industries.**Global Reach. Local Service.**



As a global leader, Pavion specializes in the design, installation, service, and maintenance of cutting\-edge fire alarm systems, critical communications, video surveillance, access control, and advanced AV technologies. Our mission is to bring clarity and transformation to safety, security, and communication through integral technology and radical service.



With a commitment to safety, reliability, and operational excellence, Pavion ensures scalable, future\-ready solutions tailored to meet and exceed our clients’ needs. Learn more at www.pavion.com (https://pavion.com/)

  



Pavion and our family of companies are seeking a talented and motivated Core Sales Representative to join our security business unit.

  


**Primary Responsibilities:**


* Prospect and acquire new commercial/industrial and public sector clients for security and fire alarm systems
* Conduct thorough needs assessments and develop customized solutions to meet clients' security and fire safety requirements
* Present product demonstrations and proposals to clients, highlighting the benefits and features of our security and fire alarm systems
* Negotiate pricing and terms of sale with clients, striving to maximize profitability while meeting client needs
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth installation and implementation of security and fire alarm systems for clients
* Maintain ongoing relationships with clients, providing post\-sale support and addressing any concerns or issues that may arise
* Stay updated on industry trends, regulations, and advancements in security and fire alarm technology to effectively communicate value propositions to clients


**Basic Qualifications:**


* Proven track record of success in sales, with a minimum of 2 years of experience selling security or fire alarm systems
* Strong understanding of security and fire alarm technology and solutions
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to build and maintain relationships with clients and internal stakeholders
* Self\-motivated and driven to meet and exceed sales targets

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or related field preferred

  




Pay Range: The salary range for this position is **$60,000–$65,000 annually, plus commission.** The starting salary will be determined based on qualifications, experience, education, skills, certifications, and internal equity. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about crafting compelling digital experiences and driving impactful marketing strategies? We are seeking a dynamic **Digital Marketing Specialist** to join our innovative team! In this role, you will lead the development and execution of comprehensive digital marketing campaigns that elevate brand visibility, boost engagement, and generate measurable results. Your expertise in SEO, paid advertising, content creation, and analytics will be instrumental in shaping our online presence and achieving business objectives. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced environment where creativity meets data\-driven decision\-making.

**Duties**

* Develop, implement, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across multiple channels including SEM (Search Engine Marketing), social media advertising, email marketing, and paid search marketing campaigns.
* Manage and monitor paid advertising campaigns using platforms such as Google Ads (Google AdWords), Facebook Advertising, and other social media advertising tools to maximize ROI.
* Conduct keyword research and utilize SEO tools to enhance organic search rankings; optimize website content for search engines using SEO best practices.
* Create engaging content for websites, blogs, social media platforms, and email campaigns that resonates with target audiences.
* Utilize web analytics reporting tools like Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager to track campaign performance, analyze user behavior, and generate actionable insights.
* Manage website content using content management systems such as WordPress; perform website management tasks including updates, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Design visually appealing graphics and multimedia assets using Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite to support marketing initiatives.
* Implement marketing automation strategies to nurture leads and improve conversion rates through personalized messaging.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to coordinate digital campaign setup, testing, and performance marketing efforts aligned with business goals.
* Monitor industry trends in digital marketing to continually refine strategies for social media management, web analytics, paid advertising campaigns, and SEO.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in digital marketing with a strong understanding of SEM, SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising campaign management, and web analytics reporting.
* Proficiency with SEO tools, Google Analytics, Google Ads (Google AdWords), Google Tag Manager, and marketing automation platforms.
* Skilled in content creation with a solid grasp of graphic design tools like Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Hands\-on experience managing websites using WordPress or similar content management systems; familiarity with HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to manage paid advertising campaigns across multiple channels including Facebook Advertising and Google Ads.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data from web analytics tools to inform strategy adjustments.
* Excellent communication skills for creating compelling content and collaborating effectively with team members.
* Technical proficiency in website management, keyword research, performance marketing tactics, and social media management platforms.
* Knowledge of e\-commerce platforms is advantageous for supporting online sales initiatives.

Join us as a Digital Marketing Specialist where your innovative ideas will shape our digital footprint! Bring your enthusiasm for digital strategy combined with technical expertise — together we’ll create impactful campaigns that drive growth and engagement across all channels!

Pay: $26\.24 \- $28\.93 per hour

Expected hours: 5\.0 – 10\.0 per week

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Production Coordinator (Project Hire)
jobs.description:
Lucasfilm Animation Ltd., the creators of the Emmy award\-winning animation series “Star Wars: The Clone Wars” and the highly successful animation series “Star Wars: Maul – Shadow Lord” “Star Wars Rebels,” “Star Wars Resistance,” “Star Wars: The Bad Batch,” “Tales of the Jedi” and “Tales of the Empire” are looking for a Production Coordinator for the Storyboard and Layout departments who reflects the innovative spirit, creative talent, production excellence, collaborative mindset and passion for great filmmaking that defines Lucasfilm Ltd..

### **Responsibilities:**

* Provides production support to the Story team – Supervising Director, Episodic Directors, Story Artists, APM and Producer.
* Acts as administrative and back\-up support to the APM to ensure all production events are run smoothly and executed efficiently.
* Assists with preparation for an episode, populating internal production/creative tracking system with necessary data in order for the Story team to begin storyboarding.
* Additionally tracks requests from the Story team to corresponding departments as modifications are needed.
* Schedules and organizes meetings for various departments.
* Researches and gathers materials and information necessary for the preparation and execution of production, such as preparing all paperwork and setup required for turnovers and kickoffs both internally and overseas.
* Responsible for creating meeting notes, follow\-ups, documents and schedules as required.
* Assists with uploads and downloads of media.
* Prepares routine correspondence and forms. Packages, ships, and tracks electronic files and deliverables as necessary.
* Completes special projects as needed or requested.

### **Qualifications:**

* 3 years of experience in Production, preferably in Animation.
* Requires excellent administrative and detailed note taking skills, including word processing, strong working knowledge of the Google Suite, Word, Excel and Outlook.
* Must be capable of working independently and as part of a team. Needs to demonstrate a high level of initiative, flexibility and confidentiality.
* Strong attention to detail, time management, communication, and follow up/follow through skills required.
* Experience or interest in the areas of Storyboarding or Scripts.
* Ability to multi\-task efficiently within a high\-pressure, fast paced environment while meeting strict deadlines.

### **Education:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Animation, Art, Film or related field preferred but not required.

  


The hiring range for this position in San Francisco is $64,600 to $83,400 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Landscape Project Coordinator: PT with Room for Advancement
jobs.description:
Part\-Time Landscape Project Coordinator

**Rendered Stone Landscapes \| East Bay, CA**  
**Starting at 10\-15 hours/week, with potential to grow to twice that \+**  
**$28\-30/hour to start DOE**

Rendered Stone Landscapes is looking for a **highly organized, reliable, and people\-oriented Project Coordinator** to help coordinate our landscape installation projects and become an important part of our client experience.

This is a part\-time position to start, with approximately **10\-15 hours per week and the potential to grow** to twice that as the role expands. For the first few months, you will work closely with the owners to learn our projects, systems, clients, crew, and standards. As you become comfortable in the role, you will gradually take on more responsibility for day\-to\-day project coordination, with the goal of eventually taking over much of the day\-to\-day coordination while continuing to work closely with the ownership team.

**What You'll Do**

You will help guide projects from the beginning of construction through completion, working closely with our clients, field crew, vendors, office team and company owners.

**Responsibilities will include:**

* Serving as a primary point of contact for clients during active construction
* Communicating clearly, professionally, kindly, and proactively with clients
* Coordinating schedules, materials, deliveries, subcontractors, and jobsite logistics
* Visiting active jobsites to monitor progress, organization, and quality
* Reviewing plans and ensuring the work being built reflects the approved design and scope
* Maintaining high standards for craftsmanship, details, cleanliness, and overall presentation
* Communicating clearly with the field crew and helping resolve questions or issues as they arise
* Identifying potential problems early and helping develop practical solutions
* Keeping projects organized and on track with established scope, schedule, and cost targets
* Documenting project progress, decisions, changes, and client communication
* Helping coordinate change requests and ensuring work outside the approved scope is properly addressed
* Participating in client meetings, site walks, and project closeouts

**Program Coordinator, San Francisco** 

**Organization:** The Thriving Initiative **Location:** Hybrid (Approximately 75% remote, 25% in\-person)\| San Francisco, CA

**Employment Type:** Part\-Time **Hours:** 10\-15 hours per week **Compensation:** $20–$22 per hour

**Who We Are**

The Thriving Initiative is a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit serving survivors on college campuses including San Francisco State University, San Diego State University, and UC Santa Barbara. Our programs are survivor\-centered, trauma\-informed, and grounded in deep respect for community healing.

We are a small but highly committed team. Every staff member is here because they believe in this work. We value innovation, empathy, community, and respect.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator plays a vital role in the day\-to\-day program operations and community\-facing presence of The Thriving Initiative at San Francisco State University (SFSU) and in the broader San Francisco community. This role will support the planning and execution of events and workshops, build and nurture campus and community partnerships, and serve as an accessible point of contact for students seeking resources and connection. The ideal candidate is organized, empathetic, and passionate about improving the lives of survivors. This role reports to the Program Operations Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program \& Event Support**

* Oversee and implement weekly in\-person healing and recovery workshops utilizing diverse alternative forms of healing
* Oversee logistics for events and workshops, including ordering and bringing physical workshop materials, setting up venues, and coordinating with service providers before, during, and after each event.
* Attend weekly staff meetings and a weekly one\-on\-one meeting with the Program Manager
* Works collaboratively with program team to ensure smooth program operations
* Attend and support both on\-campus and off\-campus planned events
* Assist with financial management related to events and workshops, including tracking expenditures and processing orders
* Oversee participant intake and attendance rosters for all sessions
* Assist with additional projects that are assigned

**Student Engagement**

* Directly coordinate all SFSU volunteer engagement activities and oversight.
* Hold regular weekly office hours to provide student volunteers with an accessible, welcoming space to connect, ask questions, and plan activities
* Plan and coordinate bonding activities for student officers to build community and team cohesion
* Draft communication and outreach templates to streamline student officer tasks and outreach efforts

* Collaborate with on\-campus partners in planning and delivering programming and events

* Closely collaborate with Communications and Outreach coordinator to co\-lead weekly marketing meetings, ensure proper volunteer engagement, and appropriate content creation

**Partnership Development**

* Cultivate and maintain on\-campus partnerships with relevant university departments, student organizations, and offices

* Commitment to supporting survivors of interpersonal violence and sexual assault

* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work collaboratively with volunteers, staff, workshop participants, and community partners
* Comfort with basic financial tracking and administrative tasks
* Knowledge of San Francisco State University clubs, organizations, administration, etc.
* Reliable transportation to and from events
* Must be able to transport workshop materials to and from program sites in a timely manner, including loading and unloading supplies up to 25 pounds, reasonable accommodations can be made.

**Preferred**

* Experience in event planning, program coordination, or nonprofit work
* Experience working with or within campus communities
* Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience
* Trauma\-informed training will be provided, but previous mental health experience is a major plus

**Working Conditions**

This is a part\-time, hybrid position with in\-person requirements near San Francisco State University campus. Some off\-campus travel for events and community partnerships may be required. Hours may occasionally vary around events and workshops.

* **Hours:** Approximately 15 hours per week

**Program** **Coordinator**


**Location:** Hybrid; California\-based, with a strong preference for the San Francisco Bay Area  

**Status:** Full\-time, Exempt  

**Reports to:** Senior Program Manager


**Salary** Range: $58,839\-$88,259


**About the Center for Care Innovations**  

The Center for Care Innovations (CCI) is a nonprofit organization working to transform the health care safety net. Our mission is to spark, seed, and spread innovations that strengthen the health and wellbeing of historically underinvested communities.  

  

For more than 25 years, CCI has worked alongside safety net organizations to navigate a changing health care landscape, test new approaches, strengthen organizations and leaders, and help promising ideas spread across the field. Rooted in California, we partner with community health centers, public hospitals, community\-based organizations, managed care plans, public agencies, and philanthropy.  

  

Our work spans capacity\-building initiatives, advising and consulting, and ecosystem development: running intensive learning collaboratives and accelerators, providing tailored advising and research, and hosting cross\-sector gatherings. These bring people together to tackle some of the health care safety net's most pressing challenges.  

  

For more information, please see the www.careinnovations.org (http://www.careinnovations.org/).
  

  

**About the Program Coordinator Role**


CCI is looking for a collaborative, proactive, and organized Program Coordinator to support initiatives that help health care safety net organizations improve care and advance health equity. This is a great role for someone who has experience supporting complex initiatives and enjoys keeping many moving pieces organized, anticipating what different stakeholders need, and creating a thoughtful experience for participants and partners.  

  

You'll work across multiple CCI initiatives and team configurations, building your experience in project management, health systems improvement, events and learning experiences, and partner engagement. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work while thriving as part of a collaborative, matrixed team.  

  

**What** **You'll Do**


* **Keep multiple initiatives organized and moving forward.** Coordinate day\-to\-day activities across multiple initiatives, tracking tasks, timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Maintain work plans and knowledge management systems, anticipate needs, and help ensure important details don't fall through the cracks.


* **Coordinate meetings and keep teams connected.** Manage scheduling, prepare agendas, presentations, reports, participant resources, and other materials, take notes, and document and track action items across internal and external meetings.


* **Create seamless and welcoming participant experiences.** Serve as a responsive point of contact for participants and partners, anticipate their needs, communicate clearly and warmly, and troubleshoot issues throughout CCI initiatives.


* **Coordinate high\-quality in\-person and virtual events.** Partner to plan and host highly interactive convenings, workshops, conferences, and other learning experiences. Coordinate venues, vendors, registration, participant communications, speakers, materials, on\-site logistics, and virtual platforms such as Zoom.


* **Support communications and learning materials.** Draft participant communications, newsletters, presentations, and other resources, and coordinate with CCI colleagues on initiative webpages, external communications, and learning materials.


* **Use data to support learning and improvement.** Maintain accurate participant and engagement data, including attendance, satisfaction surveys, and other initiative information in Salesforce and CCI's other tracking systems. Gather and synthesize participant feedback, prepare reports and summaries, and help teams identify trends, successes, and opportunities for improvement.


* **Support grants, contracts, and initiative finances.** Track deliverables, contracts, invoices, expenses, and related documentation in partnership with initiative leads.


**You Might Be a Great Fit If You...**


* Have at least three years of relevant experience supporting or coordinating complex initiatives, ideally in health care, public health, nonprofit, community\-based, or related settings.


* Have a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


* Have experience supporting multiple initiatives simultaneously and using work plans, timelines, task tracking, and other tools to keep complex work moving forward.


* Are self\-motivated and organized, with strong time\-management skills and the ability to manage changing priorities independently while collaborating effectively with a team.


* Have experience planning and hosting in\-person events, convenings, or other complex gatherings.


* Bring a strong participant, partner, or customer\-service orientation and enjoy making sure people feel welcomed, informed, and well supported.


* Are a clear and thoughtful communicator who can develop polished emails, presentations, meeting materials, participant resources, and other communications for different audiences.


* Bring some familiarity with California's health care safety net ecosystem actors (i.e Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), Medi\-Cal Managed Care Plans (MCPs) and key reforms (i.e. CalAIM) and are interested in continuing to deepen that knowledge.

* Are comfortable working with data and spreadsheets and can maintain accurate information, identify basic trends, and turn data and feedback into useful summaries.
