jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator 2
jobs.description:
Stanford University's Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Spine Division is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Clinical Research Coordinator 2 (CRC2\) to support the research program. This position plays a central and independent role in managing all aspects of PI’s research portfolio, including industry\-funded clinical trials, multi\-site collaborations, registry studies, and grant\-funded projects including PI\-Initiated projects. The CRC2 serves as the primary research contact for sponsors, collaborators, IRBs, and internal stakeholders, and will work closely with surgical faculty, residents, fellows, and students.


This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced research professional seeking meaningful responsibility in a dynamic academic medical center environment.


Must possess and maintain a valid California non\-commercial Class C Driver’s License.


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS\*:**

* Ability to drive day or night.
* Frequently stand, walk, twist, bend, stoop, squat and use fine light/fine grasping.
* Occasionally sit, reach above shoulders, perform desk based computer tasks, use a telephone and write by hand, lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh up to 40 pounds.
* Rarely kneel, crawl, climb ladders, grasp forcefully, sort and file paperwork or parts, rarely lift, carry, push, and pull objects that weigh 40 pounds or more.

*\* \- Consistent with its obligations under the law, the University will provide reasonable accommodation to any employee with a disability who requires accommodation to perform the essential functions of his or her job.*

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* Position may at times require the employee to work with or be in areas where hazardous materials and/or exposure to chemicals, blood, body fluid or tissues and risk of exposure to contagious diseases and infections.
May require extended or unusual work hours based on research requirements and business needs  
* 

**WORK STANDARDS:**

* When conducting university business, must comply with California Vehicle Code and Stanford University driving requirements.
* Interpersonal Skills: Demonstrates the ability to work well with Stanford colleagues and clients and with external organizations.
* Promote Culture of Safety: Demonstrates commitment to personal responsibility and value for safety; communicates safety concerns; uses and promotes safe behaviors based on training and lessons learned.
* Subject to and expected to comply with all applicable University policies and procedures, including but not limited to the personnel policies and other policies found in the University's Administrative Guide, http://adminguide.stanford.edu .

  
**Core Duties** :


* Oversee subject recruitment and study enrollment goals. Determine effective strategies for promoting/recruiting research participants and retaining participants in long\-term clinical trials.
* Oversee data management for research projects. Develop and manage systems to organize, collect, report, and monitor data collection. Extract, analyze, and interpret data.
* Develop project schedules, targets, measurements, and accountabilities, as assigned. Lead team meetings and prepare/approve minutes.
* Formally supervise, train, and/or mentor new staff or students, as assigned, potentially including hiring, preparing or assisting with the preparation of performance evaluations, and performing related duties, in addition to instruction on project work.
* Audit operations, including laboratory procedures, to ensure compliance with applicable regulations; provide leadership in identifying and implementing corrective actions/processes. Monitor Institutional Review Board submissions and respond to requests and questions.
* Collaborate with principal investigators and study sponsors, monitor and report serious adverse events, and resolve study queries.
* Provide leadership in determining, recommending, and implementing improvements to policies/processes; define best practices.
* Develop study budget with staff and principal investigator, identifying standard of care versus study procedures. Track patient and study specific milestones, and invoice sponsors according to study contract.
* Ensure regulatory compliance. Regularly inspect study documents to ensure ongoing regulatory compliance.
Work with principal investigator to ensure Investigational New Drug applications are submitted to the FDA when applicable. Ensure Institutional Review Board renewals are completed.  
* 

**Minimum Education** **and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and two years of experience in clinical research, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.


**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** :


* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and database applications.
* Experience with research protocols and regulatory or governing bodies, which include HIPAA and FDA regulations, Institutional Review Board requirements, and Good Clinical Practices.
Knowledge of medical terminology.  
* 

**Certificates and Licenses Required**

Society of Clinical Research Associates or Association of Clinical Research Professionals certification is preferred.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Driving continued aggressive growth in our Enterprise business is a continued high priority. In the rapidly growing world of GenAI, multi\-modality is increasingly becoming a requirement.

  

In addition to text, use cases demand computer vision with reasoning, world action and speech modalities. We need an account manager to passionately drive these technologies in the Enterprise and win NVIDIA platform (Software \+ Hardware) adoption. You will drive GTM (go to market) aspects of the collaboration including but not limited to defining our GTM strategy (industry, partners), sales enablement materials, train partner and field, working with the sales account team on creating and closing pipeline opportunities and provide feedback to the product team based on customer requirements. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!

 **What you'll be doing:**

* Elevate and prioritize the most promising NVIDIA DSX, AI Infrastructure, EDA, and semiconductor ecosystem providers based on their capacity to scale, attract capital, and drive sustained sales offtake, while ensuring alignment with NVIDIA’s strategic priorities.

* Deliver incremental revenue and pipeline growth quarter over quarter, including the ability to structure and close complex business deals.
* Partner with internal teams to design full\-system solutions that enable the cloud business; provide ongoing strategic, product, and tactical feedback from headquarters.
* Collaborate closely with product, sales, and partnerships teams to maintain alignment on strategic priorities and execution.
* Represent NVIDIA at strategic industry forums; identify and drive participation in high\-value ecosystem events to build visibility, relationships, and partnerships.
* Own the event strategy, including evaluation, prioritization, and coverage planning for NVIDIA\-led and third\-party industry events.

**What we need to see:**

* 5\+ years of technology sales leadership experience with a consistent record of exceeding revenue and growth targets.
* Deep AI/ML domain expertise, particularly in enterprise AI, foundation models, and large language models (LLMs).

jobs.description:

Join us at AIT, where we believe every day presents an opportunity to make a global impact!  

We’re problem solvers, driven by our curiosity and creativity, in endless pursuit of solutions for our customers. Together, we champion the strength of our global teams. Overview:

The **Domestic Customer Account Manager** is responsible for day\-to\-day management of, and expanding, the client relationship. In addition, the role will be responsible for customer service (24/7\), tracking, routing, problem resolution, vendor compliance, account profitability, and all other assigned projects as dictated by the needs of the client. This role requires excellent organizational and communication skills while working in a high volume and fast paced environment. The Customer Account Manager is the primary point of contact for a large revenue\-producing and more complex customer base responsible for all steps in the logistics process for these customer(s), which may not be routine in nature.
Responsibilities:
* High visibility role acting as the primary contact for larger, more complex or high\-revenue producing customers, responsible for the outcome of assigned projects and customized client solutions.
* Main point of contact for clients supporting all of their logistics needs from beginning to end, including:
* + Ability to quote and route freight across multiple transportation channels and services
	+ Track and trace shipments daily
	+ Able to troubleshoot and overcome operational challenges
	+ Act as the local point\-of\-contact for all client inquiries, both operational and sales related
	+ Provide timely analysis and monitor freight cost metrics
* Work with multiple decision\-makers within the assigned account to drive business development through multiple channels
* Adhere to TSA and other government regulatory compliance standards with regards to booking, routing of all air, ground and sea cargo
* Achieve service goals by working with various AIT internal groups to develop, implement and monitor logistic metrics
* Work with the client on any and all reporting requests
* Responsible for development and updating SOPs for various business segments
* All other duties as needed
* The wage range for this position is $71,860\.00\-$107,780\.00 and may vary based on geography as well as relative knowledge, skills, abilities, and experience.


Qualifications:
* Minimum basic qualifications: High school degree or GED required
* Associates degree or higher preferred
* 3\-5 years previous Freight Forwarding experience
* Proficient in MS Word, Excel, AS400 experience preferred, but not required
* Ability to multi\-task with strong attention to detail
* Must be able to work in a team setting and autonomously to determine resources to meet and exceed company and customer expectations
* Ability to problem solve and be solution oriented
* Individual must have a self\-starter mentality and is adaptive and flexible
* Ability to calculate freight rates and amounts such percentages, area, circumference, and volume


What AIT Can Offer You:

In addition to your base compensation, you may be eligible for a bonus based on achievement of business and/or individual performance metrics (dependent on position). Benefits offered include Medical, Prescription, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, Dental, Vision, Life, AD\&D, Disability, Supplemental Health, Employee Support, Paid Parental Leave, Pet Insurance, 401(k) and Tuition Reimbursement. In addition, teammates may be eligible for up to 10 to 20 days of vacation (depending on tenure), 2 personal days, 1 floating holiday, 5 sick days, 5 volunteer hours, and 6 company holidays (plus Veterans Day for Veterans) annually.
About AIT Worldwide:

AIT Worldwide Logistics is a global freight forwarder that helps companies grow by expanding access to markets all over the world where they can sell and/or procure their raw materials, components and finished goods. For more than 40 years, the Chicago\-based supply chain solutions leader has relied on a consultative approach to build a global network and trusted partnerships in nearly every industry, including aerospace, automotive, consumer retail, energy, food, government, high\-tech, industrial, life sciences and marine. Backed by scalable, user\-friendly technology, AIT’s flexible business model customizes door\-to\-door deliveries via sea, air, ground and rail—on time and on budget. With expert teammates staffing more than 150 worldwide locations in Asia, Europe and North America, AIT’s full\-service options also include customs clearance, warehouse management and white glove services. *AIT Worldwide Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer – M/F/Veterans/Disabled. If you are unable to apply online due to a disability, contact Human Resources at 630\-766\-8300 ext 5218\.*

jobs.description:
**Role Summary:**

The Sales Account Manager for Custom \& Proprietary publishing plays a critical role in driving the day\-to\-day execution and account management of our custom product offerings. Reporting directly to the Director of Custom Publishing, this role serves as the primary operational liaison for select retail, licensing, and brand partners. The ideal candidate will bridge client needs with internal editorial and production workflows, track data to inform executive strategy, and ensure that custom publishing projects are delivered on time, within budget, and optimized for market success.

**Strategic Oversight \& Core Responsibilities**

· **Dedicated Account Management:** Serve as the primary day\-to\-day contact for select custom publishing clients, ensuring proactive communication, prompt issue resolution, and exceptional client satisfaction throughout the product lifecycle.

· **Relationship Building:** Create, maintain, and foster excellent personal and professional relationships with end\-customer buyers as well as all product management staff.

· **Proactive Partner Strategy:** Assist brand and retail partners with proprietary products, including positioning, configuration, and sales strategy, to help drive sell\-through. Continually keep customers up to date on marketing initiatives to drive demand and secure increased placement for custom titles.

· **Revenue Operations \& Reporting:** Track account health, manage the intake and routing of purchase orders, and build reporting tools to monitor pipeline opportunities and project progress. Monitor, report on, and contextualize Point of Sale (POS) data by title and customer to identify performance trends.

Cross\-Functional Collaboration

Immediately communicate demand opportunities to the operations team and verify product availability before committing to external partners.

· **Internal Liaison:** Act as the operational bridge between the external client and internal creative/production teams, translating client feedback into actionable tasks.

· **Intake Assistance:** Support the centralized triage protocol by helping to log, track, and organize inbound partnership and custom product inquiries.

**Qualifications \& Experience**

· 2–4 years of experience in account management, B2B sales support, or publishing operations.

· Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client accounts and concurrent project lifecycles.

· Strong understanding of client relationship management, forecasting, and cross\-functional team coordination.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a high degree of comfort interfacing directly with external brand partners.

· Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and capable of thriving in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.

· Comfort building highly visual presentations to showcase custom products, alongside data\-driven executive reporting, is a plus.

jobs.description:
**Account Manager**
Sales Department*Job Description* **Position Summary:** Mirapath is looking for a goal\-oriented Territory Account Manager to cultivate and expand our footprint in the South Central territory. This role focuses on acquiring new business logos, generating a robust sales pipeline, fostering connections with potential clients, and growing strategic current accounts.
The ideal candidate will have existing industry ties in AI infrastructure, data centers, enterprise IT, colocation, or critical facilities, along with a history of sourcing and securing new ventures independently. This is a field\-based remote role. **Work Arrangement**: On\-site, Hybrid \& Remote

**Multiple Locations**: CA, MN, TX, VA

**Compensation**: Competitive Base Salary \+ Uncapped Commission (60/40 OTE Split \+ Performance Accelerators)**Position Responsibilities**
=============================

**Sales \& Revenue Growth**
===========================

* **Own new\-logo acquisition and revenue growth across the assigned territory.**
* Develop and execute a territory plan that identifies priority markets, target accounts, key stakeholders, partner relationships, and near\-term opportunities.
* Build and maintain a self\-generated pipeline through existing relationships, direct prospecting, referrals, industry associations, manufacturer and partner networks, events, phone, email, LinkedIn, and coordinated marketing activities.
* Drive sales for assigned accounts by building rapport, understanding account requirements, explaining product/service capabilities, negotiating contract terms, and finalizing contracts
* Expand sales (upsell) in assigned accounts by introducing new products and services
* Initiate sales process by scheduling appointments, making initial presentations, and understanding account requirements
* Recommend new products and services by evaluating current product results and identifying needs to be filled
* Monitor competition by gathering current marketplace information on pricing, products, new products, delivery schedules, and merchandising techniques
* Participate in team meetings and take responsibility for sales improvement initiatives

**Client Relationship Management**
----------------------------------

* **Build and maintain strong client relationships**
* Manage and resolve client concerns/issues during the entire sales cycle
* Provide product and pricing information by clarifying customer requests, selecting appropriate information, and answering questions
* Develop multithreaded relationships with data center, IT, network, facilities, engineering, procurement, operations, and executive stakeholders.
* Provide quality customer service in assisting customers on questions and/or requests
* Represent Mirapath at customer meetings, industry events, partner engagements, and regional networking opportunities.
* Explain the scope of all solutions and position them in relation to an organization's requirements

**Cross\-Functional and Internal Collaboration**
------------------------------------------------

* **Communicate, liaise, and negotiate internally and externally to facilitate the development of profitable business and sustainable relationships**
* Lead the complete sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through solution development, proposal, negotiation, closing, and post\-sale account expansion.
* Keep management informed by submitting activity and results reports
* Develop and tailor materials to assist the sales team in explaining key features \& benefits
* Work collaboratively and productively with other departments to meet customer needs
* Create processes that improve efficiencies and gather consensus and buy\-in from those involved

**Additional Responsibilities**
-------------------------------

* **Maintain all aspects of client records, including meeting notes and activities, in CRM database**
* Provide regular territory forecasts, pipeline updates, competitive intelligence, and account\-development plans to sales leadership.
* Develop and maintain knowledge of Mirapath's product set; participate in educational opportunities
* Attend internal meetings, exhibitions, and events as required
* Contribute to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed

 **Position Requirements*** BA/BS in a business or technical related field or equivalent combination of education and experience required. MBA a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience selling relevant and related products; experience with data center/IT infrastructure products a plus.
* Proficient computer, software, and data analysis skills (Salesforce.com/CRM, Excel, Outlook, Word, Power Point)
* Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals
* Demonstrate strong initiative, resiliency, organizational and time management skills
* Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills.
* Excellent problem solver with strong negotiation and presentation skills
* Proven record in business development and account planning/management.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Resourceful and ability to adapt quickly to changing environment
* Ability to effectively prioritize tasks and manage time within a fast\-paced environment
* Travel up to 25% of the time

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------


Credit Genie is a mobile\-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long\-term financial stability.

  

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017\). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting\-edge technology and customer\-centric solutions.

**Overview:**

As an Integrated Marketing Lead at Credit Genie, you will be responsible for owning how our brand shows up across every channel our audience touches. This is a broad, senior individual\-contributor role that brings brand marketing, social media, and influencer marketing under one roof, with the ownership to set strategy and execute it.


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

**What You'll Do:**


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

* **Be a brand ambassador.** Act as a champion and guardian of the Credit Genie brand executing our positioning, voice, and visual identity consistently across every touchpoint, and building brand awareness and consideration through on\-brand creative and brand\-building programs, including brand campaigns across channels such as OOH, video, and digital.
* **Build and own social strategy.** Establish Credit Genie's social media strategy from the ground up and own it end to end across all major platforms. Partner with the design team to develop campaigns, manage the content pipeline and editorial calendar, maintain a consistent brand presence, and tailor content to the strengths and audience of each platform.
* **Own influencer and creator marketing end to end.** Own the strategy and execute the full program: sourcing, vetting, briefing, contracting, content review, and reporting. Turning partnerships into organic growth in following and recognition.
* **Build the employer brand.** Partner with the people team to tell Credit Genie's story as a place to work. Culture and employee content that attracts talent and a strong presence on platforms like LinkedIn and Glassdoor.
* **Own integrated go\-to\-market.** Translate business goals into integrated campaigns that span brand, social, influencer, PR, OOH, and lifecycle channels — owning them from concept through launch and optimization as one coherent story.
* **Be the voice of our community.** Engage customers across social networks, nurture our communities, and protect brand sentiment.
* **Drive PR and communications.** Lead media relations, press materials, and announcement plans; secure earned coverage; and support launches, milestones, and issues and reputation management with leadership and legal.
* **Lead across the company.** Align partners across growth, design, product, customer service, and people, influencing cross\-functional teams without direct authority to deliver business outcomes and keep the brand consistent everywhere.
* **Measure, experiment, and optimize.** Define KPIs, run tests, and turn results and consumer insight into recommendations that shape strategy and investment — using web and social analytics tools (e.g., Sprout Social, Google Analytics, Sigma).

 **Requirements:**

* 7\+ years of experience leading all aspects of social strategy across major platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, and YouTube.
* Proven track record of building awareness and consideration
* Hands\-on experience owning influencer and creator marketing end to end: sourcing, briefing, contracting, managing partnerships, and measuring ROI.
* Proven track record of growing and managing social communities — day\-to\-day operations, growth, engagement campaigns, content strategy, and measurement.
* Successful experience partnering on employer branding initiatives and supporting the development of a strong internal and external brand narrative.
* Experience leading PR and communications \- pitching media, drafting press materials, securing earned coverage, and supporting issues and reputation management.
* Experience managing and measuring both ongoing and campaign\-specific social programs.
* Excellent creative judgment paired with a data\-driven mindset, with sharp attention to detail and strong organization.
* Strong analytical skills and experience with web and social media analytics tools and reporting (e.g., Hootsuite, Google Analytics, Sprout Social, Tableau).
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and building new programs from the ground up, with a collaborative style that influences cross\-functional teams without direct authority.
* Experience with consumer fintech or related industries is a plus.

* Automobile allowance
* Entertainment allowance
* Paid time off
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Generous 401(k) matching program


Excellent opportunity to become a vital team player within our fast\-growing organization!

* 3\-to\-5\-year successful sales experience with healthcare facilities, physicians, home health, hospice, and other healthcare related entities

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open\-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large\-scale data workloads — without sacrificing developer experience.

We host the databases behind companies like Cash App, Intercom, and Cursor. In other words: important databases.

* Find promising companies that should be using PlanetScale, but aren’t yet.

**These attributes describe you.**

**What you will need.**

Not literal points. We do not have a leaderboard. But these will help:

**Why PlanetScale**

We're redefining how high\-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS.



PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

Location: Oakland, CA, United States

**Description**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals is seeking experienced, high\-performing, and driven **Specialty Sales Representatives** to join our expanding commercial organization. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

GREWE supports over 75,000 Amex colleagues and contractors in over eight million square feet of property located in 59 countries.

**POSITION DETAILS**


The Academic Program Coordinator is responsible for managing and coordinating all personnel and


human resources functions for the Office of Collaborative Programs. The position supports a large


and diverse workforce across multiple academic, workforce development, and grant\-funded


programs and serves as the primary liaison between the department, Kingsborough Human


Resources, the Research Foundation, and other campus offices.


Responsibilities include:


* Coordinate all phases of recruitment, hiring, onboarding, and separation processes for full


time staff, adjunct faculty, College Assistants, Continuing Education instructors, Research


Foundation employees, and seasonal personnel.

employment documentation in accordance with CUNY, Kingsborough Community College,


and Research Foundation policies and procedures.


* Serve as the department's primary liaison with Human Resources, Payroll, Budget, Business


Affairs, and the Research Foundation on personnel matters.


* Maintain accurate employee records and ensure compliance with federal, state, CUNY,


college, and grant\-funded program requirements.


* Monitor employee time and leave records and coordinate payroll submissions to ensure


timely and accurate compensation.


* Track personnel budgets, staffing allocations, position vacancies, and employment funding


sources.


* Support hiring managers and program directors in developing position descriptions, posting


vacancies, screening candidates, and coordinating interviews.


* Manage onboarding activities, including employment verification, orientation, training


coordination, and required compliance documentation.


* Provide guidance and support to supervisors and employees regarding personnel policies,


procedures, timekeeping, and employment\-related matters.


* Coordinate employment actions for grant\-funded and externally funded staff and ensure


adherence to funding agency requirements.


* Prepare reports related to staffing, payroll, personnel activity, and compliance for internal


and external stakeholders.


* Maintain confidentiality of personnel records and sensitive employee information.


* Assist with audits, compliance reviews, and reporting requirements related to human


resources operations.


* Develop and implement procedures that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of


personnel processes within the Office of Collaborative Programs.


* Support strategic workforce planning initiatives to ensure adequate staffing for academic,


workforce development, and student support programs.


* Perform related duties as assigned in support of departmental and institutional goal

Bachelor's Degree required.


The College Now Academic Program Coordinator should possess a combination of administrative, organizational, communication, and student\-centered skills to successfully support academic programs and goals.

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company:** MAP Restaurant Supplies  
**Location:** Newark, New Jersey  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site  
**Salary:** $50,000–$65,000 per year, depending on experience

**About MAP Restaurant Supplies**

MAP Restaurant Supplies is a second\-generation, family\-owned foodservice equipment and supplies dealership serving customers throughout the country.

Since our founding, MAP has grown from a small local business into one of the fastest\-growing foodservice equipment dealers in the United States. We support restaurants, schools, healthcare facilities, hospitality groups, franchise organizations, and other foodservice operators with equipment, supplies, design services, installation coordination, and ongoing purchasing support.

Our culture is built around relationships, teamwork, accountability, and taking care of our customers. At MAP, we believe that once you become part of our team, you become part of our chosen family.

Rooted in Relationships. Built for Foodservice.

**Position Overview**

MAP Restaurant Supplies is seeking a creative, organized, and motivated Marketing Coordinator to help execute our ongoing marketing initiatives.

This is a hands\-on position for someone who enjoys turning ideas into finished work. The Marketing Coordinator will support social media, email campaigns, website updates, company events, vendor promotions, short\-form video production, and the creation of sales and marketing materials.

We are looking for someone who can work within MAP’s established brand direction, manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and consistently move projects from concept through completion.

The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail\-oriented, comfortable using modern marketing and design applications, and experienced with AI\-assisted content creation and video editing using CapCut.

Key ResponsibilitiesSocial Media and Content

* Manage MAP’s day\-to\-day presence across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant platforms
* Develop and maintain a consistent social media content calendar
* Create posts highlighting completed projects, new products, employee accomplishments, vendor partnerships, company events, and community involvement
* Write clear and engaging captions that reflect MAP’s brand and company culture
* Capture and organize photos and videos from the showroom, warehouse, events, training sessions, and customer projects
* Monitor engagement and maintain a timely, professional posting schedule
* Repurpose content across multiple marketing channels and formats

**AI\-Assisted Marketing**

* Use AI tools to support content development, campaign planning, research, copywriting, editing, idea generation, and other repeatable marketing tasks
* Use applications such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or comparable platforms to improve productivity and content quality
* Review all AI\-generated work for accuracy, tone, originality, and alignment with MAP’s brand
* Identify new AI tools and applications that could improve marketing quality, efficiency, and turnaround time
* Maintain human oversight of all AI\-assisted work
* Protect confidential company, customer, employee, and vendor information when using AI tools

**Video Creation and Editing**

* Create and edit short\-form videos using CapCut
* Produce content for social media, company events, product demonstrations, employee features, vendor promotions, customer projects, and company announcements
* Turn raw photos and video footage into polished, brand\-consistent content
* Add captions, transitions, audio, graphics, and other appropriate video elements
* Format videos for the specific requirements of LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and other platforms
* Maintain an organized library of raw footage and completed video content

**Email Marketing and Campaigns**

* Create and distribute customer and prospect email campaigns
* Support product promotions, company announcements, newsletters, event invitations, and follow\-up communications
* Coordinate with manufacturers and vendor representatives to gather promotional content and product information
* Maintain organized contact lists and assist with audience segmentation
* Monitor campaign results and provide basic reporting on engagement and performance

**Website and Product Updates**

* Make routine updates to company website content, images, team information, product features, and announcements
* Keep website information accurate, current, and consistent with MAP’s brand
* Coordinate with internal team members and outside partners when more advanced website support is required
* Assist with online product, manufacturer, project, and service\-related content
* Regularly review website pages for outdated, inaccurate, or incomplete information

**Graphic Design and Sales Support**

* Create and update sales flyers, promotional materials, presentations, product sheets, event materials, and internal communications
* Support the sales team with professional, brand\-consistent collateral
* Maintain templates and brand standards across company materials
* Resize and prepare graphics for social media, email, print, presentations, and website use
* Organize company photography, logos, manufacturer assets, templates, and other marketing files

**Events, Promotions, and Vendor Coordination**

* Assist with customer events, manufacturer training sessions, trade shows, showroom events, and community initiatives
* Coordinate invitations, promotional materials, signage, registration information, and post\-event follow\-up
* Work with manufacturers and representatives to gather marketing assets and identify promotional opportunities
* Help manage cooperative marketing programs and track related documentation when applicable
* Attend company events and assist with photography, video, social media coverage, and event execution

**Marketing Administration**

* Maintain a marketing calendar covering campaigns, events, promotions, deadlines, and content

QUEENS

Department


Budget Division

**Job Description**
-------------------


The New York City Department of Correction (DOC) is an integral part of the City’s evolving criminal justice system, participating in reform initiatives and strategies aimed to move the City towards a smaller jail system without compromising public safety. The DOC is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our employees, visitors, volunteers, and people in our custody. Importantly, safe jails enable DOC to provide people in custody with the tools and opportunities they need to successfully re\-enter their communities. The DOC operates facilities and court commands across the five boroughs with more than 7,500 diverse professionals and knowledgeable experts.
  

  

The Department of Correction Finance \& Budget Division seeks to appoint an Executive Assistant, who under the direction of the Assistant Commissioner, of Capital and Expense Budget and the Assistant Commissioner of Finance and Fiscal Policy, will be responsible for but not limited to the following;
  

  

* Serve as the unit’s Liaison in communicating with all agency staff, other agencies and the public

Description
  
**ORGANIZATION DESCRIPTION**

Founded in 1965, the Chinese\-American Planning Council (CPC) is a social services organization advancing the social and economic well\-being of immigrant and low\-income New Yorkers through holistic services and community\-led impact. CPC is the nation’s largest Asian American social services organization and serves as a trusted community anchor to over 80,000 community members who are served by CPC annually through 50\+ high\-quality programs and services across 35 sites in New York City. (For more information, please visit: https://www.cpc\-nyc.org ).  



**JOB SUMMARY**

The Development Coordinator provides essential operational and fundraising support to CPC’s Development team. Under the supervision of the Donor Database Manager, the Coordinator assists with the day\-to\-day execution of established systems, workflows, and administrative processes, including gift and pledge processing, donor acknowledgements, Salesforce data maintenance, reconciliation, reporting, and department coordination. Working closely with the Donor Database Manager and other Development team members, the Coordinator helps ensure accurate records, timely donor recognition, and efficient fundraising operations.  



**ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Donor Engagement**

* Draft acknowledgment of letters and tax receipts for all gifts in accordance with established gift processing procedures to ensure timely, accurate, and meaningful donor recognition.
* Conduct prospect and donor research as needed to support fundraising efforts and maintain accurate donor information.

**Data Management:**

* Support the Donor Database Manager with Salesforce data entry and data hygiene, including donor information, donor relationships, pledges, donations, workplace giving, and matching gifts across multiple platforms.
* Assist with reconciling gift records with the Finance team monthly and annually.
* Assist with preparing reports for internal and external stakeholders to track fundraising progress and evaluate fundraising efforts.

**Development Operations:**

* Contribute to the creation and implementation of the fundraising plan; conduct periodic check\-ins and assessments throughout the year.
* Prepare check requests, credit card expense reports, and invoices.
* Schedule meetings, maintain calendar, organize notes and documentation, and send reminders for the team.

**Other:**

* Provide administrative and logistical support for major fundraising events.
* Support Development team initiatives and perform special projects and other duties as assigned.

  
Qualifications
  
**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree or higher and at least 2 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in nonprofit fundraising, development operations, database administration, or a related field.
* Relevant or transferable experience in required responsibilities; familiarity with the AAPI, immigrant, and low\-income communities.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Proficient in Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite; technologically proficient and quick to learn new systems. Experience with Concur, PaperSave, Robin, Canva, or similar systems preferred.
* Exhibit a high level of discretion, professionalism, and an ethical approach to fundraising.
* Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities with limited supervision while collaborating effectively as part of a team.
* Exceptional attention to detail, critical thinking, organizational skills, project management skills, and commitment to data accuracy.
* Self\-motivated, proactive, dependable, and solutions\-oriented, with the judgment to troubleshoot routine issues and escalate when appropriate.
* Flexibility in varied job assignments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and reliability.
* Willing to contribute across Development team priorities as needed.

**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS OVERVIEW**

* $30\.00 \- $36\.00 per hour; 35 hours per week with occasional evenings and weekends
CPC offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, including but not limited to generous paid time off (holiday, sick and vacation time), Medical, Dental, Vision, Basic Life Insurance Coverage, Commuter Benefits, and a 403(b) Retirement Plan  
* 

**HOW TO APPLY**

Interested individuals should submit their resume, along with a cover letter addressed to Chloe Wong, when applying online via CPC’s website: https://www.cpc\-nyc.org/jobs or selected online job boards. All documents should be submitted as one single file. Applicants may reach out to careers@cpc\-nyc.org with any questions or further inquiries.  



*CPC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. CPC values a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace and strongly encourages women, BIPOC, immigrants, LGBTQ\+, individuals with disabilities, and veterans to apply.*

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
At New York's Little Elves, excellence is our reputation. For over 30 years, we've set the platinum standard in fine interior cleaning, trusted by discerning clients, top designers, and architects, and recognized by New York Magazine and Curbed as Best Cleaning Company in New York.

We are seeking an Operations Coordinator to become part of our exceptional team. The Operations Coordinator is the first point of contact for our clients and a central support to our office team. This is a growth position. As we prepare for disciplined expansion over the next 3\-5 years, the person in this role will start by owning our client communications and booking support, and grow into broader operational responsibility as our systems and volume expand.

**About Us**

We specialize in high\-detail housekeeping and post\-construction cleaning for interior designers, architects, and luxury property managers throughout New York City. Our reputation is built on discretion, reliability, and meticulous attention to detail.

We are a small, tenured and welcoming team with over 40 employees on the field. We are a large family, with a strong community \- family culture. We have very little turnover and seek employees with similar priorities.

**Position Overview**

The Operations Coordinator is the front door to New York's Little Elves. This position owns how the office operates day to day, including: first\-line phone coverage, client email correspondence, website inquiries that bring in new work, and supports the booking process that turns those inquiries into scheduled jobs.

This is not a receptionist role. Phones and inbox are where the job begins, not where it ends. The right person will learn how the whole operation runs, take on projects that improve it, and grow with a company that is actively expanding. The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented and productive under pressure. Successful candidates thrive in a fast\-pasted environment where priorities shift quickly, are comfortable being friendly and can remain professional under pressure.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Client Communication*

● Answer incoming phone calls as the first point of contact

● Respond to client email correspondence with the care and detail our clients expect

● Manage inquiries submitted through our website

● Document client requests, reschedules, and job changes

*Booking Support*

● Support the booking process from first inquiry through confirmed job

● Gather and verify the details required to quote and schedule work accurately

● Follow up on outstanding inquiries so no request goes unanswered

*Operational Support*

● Work in our scheduling system daily and become the team's most fluent user of it

● Support the supply and inventory function alongside our operations team

● Maintain accurate client records across our systems

*Growth and Improvement*

● Take on defined projects that improve how the office runs

● Identify friction in day\-to\-day processes and bring solutions forward

● Note: Payroll, crew scheduling, and crew assignment remain with our General Manager and President. This role supports the operation; it does not run it.\*

**Qualifications**

● Experience in an administrative, coordination, client service, or office operations role

● Writes clearly and warmly. Our clients receive detailed, personal responses, and this person becomes the voice behind them

● Stays organized through constant interruption. Phones ring, emails arrive, and priorities shift within the same hour

● Curious about the whole operation rather than only their own corner of it

● Comfortable learning new software. This seat will live in a new scheduling platform every day

● Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred

● Previous work in building trades or luxury services helpful

**What We Offer**

● Salary $50,000 \+ Performance Bonus

● Comprehensive benefits, including a matching 401K retirement plan

● A clear path to greater responsibility as the company grows

● The opportunity to work with one of New York City's most respected cleaning companies

● A collaborative, tenured team with very little turnover

**Our Values**

Every person here is measured against the same five standards:

Excellence Without Compromise – Accountability at Every Level – Care for Our People, Care for Our Clients – White\-Glove Client Care – Operational Discipline Drives Growth

This company will grow based on our effort and team support.

Pay: From $50,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
***Key Responsibilities***

  

ISI Markets is looking for an experienced Sell\-Side Account Manager to manage, retain and grow a portfolio of institutional clients across the global financial markets.  



  

This is a commercially focused role with significant opportunity to expand existing relationships and drive adoption of ISI’s market\-leading fund flow intelligence, macroeconomic data, research and analytics.  



  

***What you’ll do***

  

* Own a portfolio of sell\-side client relationships, acting as the primary commercial contact.
* Build trusted relationships across research, strategy, economics, sales \& trading, capital markets, quantitative research and data teams.
* Drive renewals, retention, upsell and cross\-sell, identifying whitespace across clients, geographies and use cases.
* Leverage ISI’s established sell\-side relationships to uncover new revenue opportunities and expand adoption across the wider organisation.
* Partner with Product Sales Specialists and internal teams to develop account strategies and deliver growth.
* Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients identify new applications for ISI’s data across research, market intelligence, client engagement and capital markets workflows.
* Proactively manage renewal risk, commercial negotiations and account forecasting.
Represent the voice of the client internally, sharing market feedback and opportunities with Product and GTM teams.  
* 

  

***Experience \& Skills***

  

* Proven experience in sell\-side account management, client success or relationship management, ideally within financial data, SaaS, research or B2B information services.
* Strong understanding of how investment banks, broker\-dealers or research providers use data and analytics.
* Demonstrated success growing relationships and identifying cross\-sell and expansion opportunities within complex financial institutions.
* Credibility engaging with senior stakeholders including analysts, strategists, economists, quants and sales leaders.
* Strong commercial mindset with a track record of delivering retention and revenue growth.
* Excellent communication, presentation and relationship\-building skills.
* Genuine interest in financial markets, investor behaviour, fund flows, capital allocation and macroeconomic trends.
* Experience with Salesforce and other CRM/reporting tools.
* Understanding of APIs, data feeds and cloud delivery models is advantageous.
* Additional languages are desirable.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in economics, finance, business, mathematics or a related discipline preferred.  
* 

***About ISI Markets Group***

ISI Markets Group is a leading provider of data, research and intelligence focused on the world's fastest\-growing and highest\-potential markets. We provide the intelligence and tools that inform confident strategic, investment and risk decisions for our clients worldwide.  



  

For more information visit **isimarkets.com**

***Working for Us***

ISI Markets is an ambitious and growing group, headquartered in London, with over 750 experts across a network of 20 offices worldwide, serving customers in 70 countries. We ensure that our culture enables our people to have a meaningful and rewarding career chapter with us:  



* **Stronger Together:** You will be part of a collaborative dynamic global sales team of 150 professionals.
* **Rewarding High Performance:** We offer competitive reward and commission structures as well as quarterly sales awards for our highest performers.
* **Inclusive Environment:** We believe our diversity is what helps us to win with over 40 nationalities represented amongst our global team.
* **Innovation:** We value fresh perspectives and expect our people to contribute and share their views.
* **Career Growth Opportunities:** We invest in our people through ongoing training and have a strong track record of promotion from within.
* **Hybrid Working:** We promote hybrid working in all of our offices and trust our employees to do their best work irrespective of where they are working.

  

***Equal Opportunity***

  

ISI Markets is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and consider qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Territory Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**


The Account Manager plays a critical role in owning and advancing B2B relationships within the largest and most complex healthcare delivery networks, including health systems (HSs), Integrated Delivery Networks (IDNs), state CDC awardees, major health departments, and other large institutional accounts. Serving as the primary customer liaison, this role engages HCPs, senior\-level clinical and non\-clinical stakeholders to understand customer priorities, address unmet needs, and deliver customized, data\-driven value propositions.


The Account Manager is responsible for meeting or exceeding sales goals within an assigned territory by developing and executing a comprehensive territory and key account business plan aligned to brand strategy. This position requires the ability to confidently deliver approved scientific and clinical information to healthcare professionals, drive appropriate product utilization within approved indications, and effectively leverage organizational resources to optimize customer engagement.


Success is measured by strong account launch performance, consistent achievement of sales objectives, and sustained customer partnership development.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer \& Account Management**

* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with large, organized customers, including IDNs, academic medical centers, and key decision\-makers (e.g., CMOs, Pharmacy Directors, Infectious Disease Specialists, and P\&T Committee members).
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, aligning customer needs with GSK’s brand strategy and value proposition.
* Identify and engage key clinical and non\-clinical influencers within healthcare delivery networks to ensure optimal account penetration and access.
* Discover and develop other stakeholders within key clinics and accounts.

**Sales Performance \& Territory Execution**

* Achieve and exceed sales targets by developing, implementing, and executing an integrated business plan for assigned territories and key accounts.
* Plan and prioritize activities to meet call metrics, optimizing coverage and frequency across top target customers.
* Analyze regional and local market trends to establish short\- and long\-term sales goals and inform a robust business and launch strategy.
* Manage territory budgets to effectively support sales and marketing activities.

**Clinical \& Product Expertise**

* Deliver compelling, compliant clinical brand presentations to physicians, advanced practice providers (APPs), medical staff, and appropriate clinic personnel.
* Maintain strong knowledge of assigned products, disease states, competitors, and evolving healthcare landscapes.
* Understand the internal dynamics of healthcare delivery systems, including physician hierarchies, pharmacy workflows, and nursing roles.

**Collaboration, Reporting \& Compliance**

* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Regional Sales Directors, brand teams, and internal partners to enhance territory performance and a customer experience.
* Provide insights and feedback on marketing strategies and sales effectiveness.
* Complete administrative tasks accurately and on time while executing brand strategy within the assigned geography.
* Participate in ongoing training and professional development.
* Maintain full compliance with all corporate, legal, regulatory, and industry policies.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field
* Ability to travel up to 50%, including overnight stays (based on district size)
* 3–5 years of biotech or pharmaceutical sales experience **required**
* Hepatology or Specialty sales experience **strongly preferred**
* Proven success in product launches and achieving sales targets
* Demonstrated expertise in account\-based selling and managing complex sales processes
* Strong understanding of health system business models, organizational structures, and decision\-making processes (e.g., formulary, P\&T)
* Experience engaging C\-suite and director\-level stakeholders within large healthcare delivery networks
* Ability to lead through influence in a highly matrixed organization
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data and trends into actionable business plans
* Excellent presentation, selling, and communication skills
* Strong business acumen and customer\-focused mindset
* Demonstrated commitment to compliance and ethical standards
* Flexibility, adaptability, and a passion for improving patient outcomes
* Fluency in Mandarin, Cantonese, Korean, Vietnamese or Tagalog preferred
* Valid driver’s license


The annual base salary for this position ranges from $170,000\-180,000\. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role. In addition, some positions may include a company car or car allowance and eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and / or individual performance.


At Syneos Health, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles. We also encourage you to join our Talent Network to stay connected to additional career opportunities.

**Why Syneos Health?** Here, the work is challenging, and the pace is exhilarating. By joining one of our commercial teams, you’re empowered to succeed with the support, resources, and autonomy that you need. The diversification and breadth of our new and existing partnerships create a multitude of career paths and employment opportunities. Syneos Health has launched more sales teams in the last 5 years across all major therapeutic areas than the top 25 pharma companies combined. Join our game\-changing, global company dedicated to creating better

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, Media Enablement Team
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you excited about improving the advertiser experience on one of the world's largest programmatic advertising platforms? As a Technical Account Manager on the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP) team, you will focus on improving how advertisers run Deals by identifying patterns in supply\-related issues, decreasing time to resolution, and equipping advertisers and account managers with the knowledge they need to succeed. You will work across Client Account Management, SSP Partnership, and Product and Engineering teams to balance quick fixes with long\-term supply improvements.  

You will surface patterns in support tickets that point to larger opportunities — whether that means strengthening the supply network, improving products, or helping clients and partners get more from the platform. This role calls for strong analytical ability and a solution\-oriented mindset, because the team designs solutions to prevent problems proactively rather than simply reacting to ticket volume. You should be familiar with industry trends including supply path optimization and emerging formats such as Audio, Digital Out of Home (DOOH), and live events, and comfortable communicating supply\-side capabilities to senior business and technical leaders inside and outside Amazon.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Understand advertiser goals, facilitate their usage of Deals on the DSP platform, and proactively identify optimization opportunities by working with Account Teams, Product, Engineering, and SSP partners.
* Analyze support ticket patterns and key performance trends across clients, then translate findings into data\-driven recommendations that reduce time to resolution and improve the overall advertiser experience.
* Investigate and root\-cause supply issues in partnership with Solution Architects, Product Managers, and Engineering, ensuring timely resolution while capturing insights that inform longer\-term product and process improvements.
* Provide training and operational support to internal Client Account teams, advertisers, and SSP or Publisher partners, equipping them with the knowledge to resolve common issues independently.
* Contribute to scalable playbooks and best practices that raise troubleshooting quality across the team, and share account management expertise with peers.

  

A day in the life  

You start by reviewing your troubleshooting ticket queue, root\-causing supply issues for your advertisers and prioritizing by business impact. By midday, you are partnering with engineering and product teams on a process improvement that will flag delivery issues before a ticket is even created. In the afternoon, you compile patterns from recent cases into a recommendation for leadership, then update a playbook so the broader team can apply what you learned. As you grow in the role, you spend more time designing high\-scale solutions with engineering and partners and less time in the ticket queue.  

  

About the team  

Amazon Ads helps advertisers find and connect with customers through a broad set of digital advertising solutions. Amazon DSP is Amazon's programmatic advertising product for campaigns spanning Video, Audio, and Display across Amazon properties (for example, Amazon.com, Freevee, Twitch, Fire TV, and Amazon Music) and tens of thousands of third\-party websites and apps. Our team is focused on improving the advertiser experience on the DSP platform, and we are investing in scalable tools and processes that strengthen our supply network for the long term. If you want to grow into a Solution Architect role and enjoy solving problems that sit at the intersection of advertising, technology, and client partnership, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience in e\-commerce or online advertising
* Experience in optimizing products and services based on client needs

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* • Experience building agentic tools to reduce operational workload.

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. Learn more about our benefits at https://amazon.jobs/en/benefits.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - NYC
jobs.description:
Agora is a leading SaaS and FinTech platform transforming how real estate investment firms manage their capital, investors, and operations. Trusted by 700\+ GPs, owners/operators, and investment firms globally, we help teams streamline the full lifecycle of investment management—from fundraising and onboarding to reporting, distributions, tax, and back\-office automation.


But we’re more than just software. We’re a team of bold thinkers, innovators, and real estate enthusiasts who believe complex processes should feel simple. Our platform combines modern technology with expert services, helping our customers raise more capital, deliver a better investor experience, and scale their businesses smarter.


Agora is backed by top\-tier VCs like Insight Partners and Qumra Capital, and we’re growing fast. We’ve been named one of Globes’ Most Promising Startups, recognized as a Best Start\-Up Companies to Work For by Duns 100, and one of Business Insider’s Hottest PropTech Startups.

**About the role:**


As a Sales Development Representative at Agora, you'll be on the front line of prospect outreach with the goal of generating qualified opportunities for our sales team. In this role, you will develop and own the "top\-of\-funnel" through outbound prospecting (cold calling, emailing, and social channels). You will be expected to quickly and effectively communicate our value proposition, respond to objections, and speak confidently to industry trends.


This role is essential to our team's aggressive growth targets. Success will require a growth mindset, resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to finding creative solutions.

**What your day would look like:**

* **Prospecting Expertise:** Dive into the strategic identification and enrichment of a prospect list tailored to our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), ensuring a pipeline of qualified leads ready for engagement.
* **Dynamic Multi\-Channel Outreach:** Engage with prospects through a seamless blend of phone, email, and LinkedIn interactions. Your mission is to spark interest, build relationships, and set the stage for meaningful conversations.
* **Collaborative Partnership:** Join forces with our sales team in meetings you've scheduled, playing a critical role in facilitating discussions and moving prospects through the sales funnel.
* **Inbound Lead Engagement:** Proactively reach out to inbound leads who have shown interest in our services by filling out forms or expressing curiosity. Your adeptness in quickly connecting and assessing their needs is vital for turning interest into actionable sales opportunities.
* **Skill Enhancement:** Participate in ongoing training and coaching sessions, embracing opportunities to refine your techniques and strategies in sales development, ensuring peak performance and continuous growth in your role

  

Requirements:
  

* Hardworking, committed, and driven to grow and succeed
* Self\-motivated and comfortable in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment
* Clear and persuasive communicator, able to represent yourself and the company with confidence
* Strong relationship\-builder who connects easily with new people
* Well\-organized with excellent time management skills
* Analytical, with a data\-informed approach to sales
* Experience with sales tools is a plus, but not required
* Able to work out of our Chelsea office 4\-5 days a week

**Why you’ll love working at Agora:**


At Agora, we believe people do their best work when they’re supported, trusted, and empowered to grow. Here’s what you can expect as part of our team:

* Comprehensive health insurance
* Flexible hybrid work model
* Unlimited paid time off
* Stock options and ownership opportunities
* Commuter and lunch benefits
* Team events, offsites, and an energetic company culture
* Real opportunities for personal and professional growth


We’re here for people who dream big, take ownership, and treat others with kindness and respect, while building something exceptional, together.

**Compensation:**


$60,000 base ($72k OTE)

  

Equal opportunity:  

  

Agora Software is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with our mission of serving a diverse and global audience, we value a diverse workforce and inclusive culture which reflects that. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, marital status, disability, and veteran status.


Please note that we use Spark Hire as part of our hiring process to review and assess job applications and related materials. This tool helps us screen applications more efficiently and ensure candidates meet the role requirements.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at privacy@agorareal.com.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
**Company**
-----------


Credit Genie is a mobile\-first financial wellness platform designed to help individuals take control of their financial future. We leverage artificial intelligence to provide personalized insights and are building a financial ecosystem by offering tools and services that provide instant access to cash, and building credit. Our goal is to empower every customer to achieve long\-term financial stability.

  

Founded in 2019 by Ed Harycki, former Swift Capital Founder (acquired by PayPal in 2017\). Backed by Khosla Ventures and led by industry pioneers from companies such as; PayPal, Square, and Cash App, we are well positioned to build the future of inclusive finance through cutting\-edge technology and customer\-centric solutions.

**Overview:**

As an Integrated Marketing Lead at Credit Genie, you will be responsible for owning how our brand shows up across every channel our audience touches. This is a broad, senior individual\-contributor role that brings brand marketing, social media, and influencer marketing under one roof, with the ownership to set strategy and execute it.


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

**What You'll Do:**


You will be the connective tissue across marketing: shaping our brand narrative, running an always\-on and campaign driven social presence, owning our influencer and creator program end to end, leading PR and communications, and orchestrating integrated campaigns that move people from awareness to consideration to adoption. You will partner closely with growth, design, product, customer service, and the people team to translate Credit Genie's mission into work that builds awareness, drives consideration, and earns lasting loyalty.

* **Be a brand ambassador.** Act as a champion and guardian of the Credit Genie brand executing our positioning, voice, and visual identity consistently across every touchpoint, and building brand awareness and consideration through on\-brand creative and brand\-building programs, including brand campaigns across channels such as OOH, video, and digital.
* **Build and own social strategy.** Establish Credit Genie's social media strategy from the ground up and own it end to end across all major platforms. This is a unique opportunity to play a meaningful role in the launch and growth of our cardiometabolic portfolio, including Plozasiran (siRNA targeting APOC3\), developed for patients with rare and high\-need cardiovascular conditions such as Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) and Severe Hypertriglyceridemia (SHTG).


This role is critical to delivering launch excellence by driving prescriber activation, accelerating therapy adoption, and ensuring sustained utilization within complex healthcare environments. The Specialty Sales Representative will operate with strategic agility, strong clinical acumen, and disciplined execution to positively impact patient outcomes.

**About Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals:**


Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ARWR) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company that develops medicines that treat intractable diseases by silencing the genes that cause them. Using a broad portfolio of RNA chemistries and efficient modes of delivery, Arrowhead therapies trigger the RNA interference mechanism to induce rapid, deep, and durable knockdown of target genes. RNA interference, or RNAi, is a mechanism present in living cells that inhibits the expression of a specific gene, thereby affecting the production of a specific protein. Arrowhead’s RNAi\-based therapeutics leverage this natural pathway of gene silencing.


Arrowhead is focused on developing innovative drugs for diseases with a genetic basis, typically characterized by the overproduction of one or more proteins that are involved with disease. The depth and versatility of our RNAi technologies enables us to potentially address conditions in virtually any therapeutic area and pursue disease targets that are not otherwise addressable by small molecules and biologics. Arrowhead is leading the field in bringing the promise of RNAi to address diseases outside of the liver, and our clinical pipeline includes disease targets in the liver and lung with a promising pipeline of preclinical candidates.


Arrowhead’s corporate headquarters is in Pasadena, CA with research and development teams in Madison, WI and San Diego, CA. Our employees are nimble, science\-driven innovators who are collaborating to bring new therapies to patients in need.

**About Vega**
--------------


The $250B insurance claims industry runs on fax machines, phone tag, and adjusters buried in paperwork. Cycle times stretch for months. Data is locked in legacy systems. And the workforce is aging out faster than it's being replaced.


Vega is the premier AI\-native claims TPA built to replace that entire stack. Our team is equal parts experienced insurance operators and modern technologists. The Start\-Up \& Commissioning Project Coordinator is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, documentation, and field execution required to start, test, verify, and turn over HVAC and mechanical systems on assigned projects.
